description: Land Acquisition - Uduneniya, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy  Districtt and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1812/9 of D/S Division, Doluwa
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of the land (location, extent, lot numbers), and procedures for compensation claims. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined for Type 4, specifically covering land acquisitions. There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and the specialized land focus makes it distinct from other specialized categories.
